text: 1. Pañc'ime bhikkhave ādīnavā kāyaduccarite . . . kāyasucarite . . . vacīduccarite . . . vacīsucarite . . . manoduccarite . . . manosucarite. Katame pañca? [page 268] 268 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. CCXLIV. 2-CCXLIX. 3 2. Attā pi attānaṃ na upavadati, anuvicca viññū pasaṃsanti, kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati. Ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā manosucarite ti. CCXLV.
